messages.subject: Loading library ggplot2
parts:
Hello all,

I am very far for an expert in ggplot2 and I have not used it in the last six months.   Can someone tell me what I am doing wrong loading the library?  Below the code and the error I am receiving.  Thanks a lot.





> install.packages("ggplot2")
trying URL 'http://www.icesi.edu.co/CRAN/bin/macosx/contrib/3.2/ggplot2_1.0.1.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 2662817 bytes (2.5 MB)
==================================================
downloaded 2.5 MB

tar: Failed to set default locale

The downloaded binary packages are in
/var/folders/mx/bkczpml13k32jfq7dx8z2_bm0000gn/T//RtmpOFWQ6P/downloaded_packages
> library(ggplot2)
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called 'stringi'
Error: package or namespace load failed for 'ggplot2'
>

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: Re: Loading library ggplot2
parts:
It is possible that I am also missing something here but it seems like
you are just missing the "stringi" package.

Try:

install.packages("stringi")

Then re-load both packages. That should work.

Sam
